selectionRationale: The target breadth is the normalized public locale-module filename union from the pinned Web Awesome 3.11.0 and Shoelace 2.20.1 releases; translated upstream text was not consulted.
Persian and Hebrew occur in both pinned sets, satisfy explicit consumer demand, and extend full-catalog right-to-left coverage beyond the existing Arabic catalog.
Every remaining union member is deferred until a complete original catalog and an independent translation review can be recorded instead of shipping English scaffold text.

translator.evidence: Drafted afresh from DEFAULT_STRINGS, then terminology-corrected and structurally validated in this repository; no upstream translated text was consulted. The retrievalCompareOverlap template was updated on 2026-08-10 with context-specific {left}, {right}, and {percent} composition.

reviewer.evidence: An AI-assisted independent repository review inspected the original 1,232 English/Persian message pairs in source order, identified and re-reviewed 621 semantic, grammar, register, and orthography corrections, and verified every placeholder and plural shape plus all 42 original exact-English allowlist rationales. A second independent review verified the two added Carousel announcement messages, their placeholder order and RTL punctuation, both new allowlist rationales, the exact 1,234-key catalog hash, and strict Chromium/Firefox/WebKit behavior; no upstream translated text was consulted. This records code-and-language reviews and does not claim human or native-speaker identity. An AI-assisted independent follow-up review checked the updated retrievalCompareOverlap message for Persian RTL grammar, {left}/{right}/{percent} placement, punctuation, catalog order, and the current source/catalog snapshots; it does not claim native-speaker review. A further AI-assisted independent review checked the four chart sampling and optional-feature-warning messages for Persian terminology, RTL grammar, catalog order, and the current 1,241-key source/catalog snapshots; it does not claim native-speaker review. A further AI-assisted independent review checked the three messages added in this pass (playbackStepPosition, phoneInputLabel, emojiPickerLoadError) for terminology, grammar, placeholder shape, catalog order and the current 1,244-key source/catalog snapshots. Each was derived from this catalog's own established phrasing for the same shape -- its existing position message, and its own wording for "step", "phone" and "could not load" -- rather than translated in isolation; it does not claim native-speaker review. A further AI-assisted independent review covered the 9.0.0 catalog reduction: ten orphaned keys (contactViewerOrganizationLabel, evaluationDashboardMetricLabel, heatmapCellSelectedSuffix, liteChartMarkPosition, spanTokens, subagentPanelCancel, trendIncreased, trendDecreased, trendGoodSuffix, trendBadSuffix) were removed from the source catalog and from this locale, taking it to the current 1,234-key snapshot. Each was verified unreachable from any component before removal, and a generator gate now fails on any future orphan; no surviving message changed. It does not claim native-speaker review.
